historical_reviews.deepseek: Proprietary dependency noted but no traffic or BER semantics.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds sustained-link acceptance and live-service boundary.
historical_reviews.related_cases: BF3 eye margin is electrical margin, not long-duration BER/bandwidth traffic.

original_test_intent: Drive sustained traffic across every approved BlueField-3 host PCIe link and verify negotiated bandwidth and observed bit/error behavior meet the platform qualification targets for the full duration.
original_method: Pin BF3 traffic artifact/config; map DPU serial/BDF to host path; baseline firmware/link/AER/services; approve direction/pattern/rate/duration, BER/error counting and bandwidth floor; drain conflicting services; run bounded traffic with telemetry; retain counters/throughput/link events and restore services/health.
manual_activity: DPU/network owner approves traffic envelope, duration and outage; operator coordinates live-service drain and link recovery.
safety_requirements: Do not run against live unapproved DPU services
Preserve all zero/nonzero counters and raw throughput
agent_execution_scope: Collect traffic/link/error/thermal evidence and restore services

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The guessed token contains no traffic profile, duration or BER/bandwidth acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only pinned vendor traffic configuration on explicit BF3 paths with supplied BER and bandwidth thresholds.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Long-duration traffic, BER and bandwidth coverage are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate generated/received byte and error counts, duration and throughput per BF3 path with link/AER telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes anticipated BER and acceptable bandwidth numeric.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Eye margin or firmware inventory cannot replace sustained traffic evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Application traffic and test traffic may interfere; BER requires a defined bit denominator and error source.

project_override_considerations: Project networking policy defines permitted load direction, concurrency and service downtime.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires long-duration BER/bandwidth qualification; Criteria only check readable text and firmware.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Vendor/project inputs can make a controlled run possible; review continues pending them.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row309 Wistron-NV GPU-00302-V003: approve exact BF3 traffic module/config, path map, traffic direction/pattern/rate/duration, BER counter/denominator/limit, bandwidth floor/tolerance, isolation/recovery, and map or replace unrelated readability/FW Criteria.

review_improvement: Defines the missing BER denominator and bandwidth target while preserving long-duration BF3 traffic coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: A nonzero error count is not a BER until divided by transmitted bits, and bandwidth is not comparable without direction, duration and units. Sustained service-affecting traffic therefore needs an explicit load contract and per-path counters rather than a generic PASS string.
